en-US.title: MenoCompass: Menopause Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Private symptom tracking
en-US.description:
See the patterns behind your menopause symptoms and walk into appointments with a clearer record. MenoCompass brings symptoms, sleep, medication context, lab results, movement, and notes together in one private place.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health entries stay on your device. There is no account, cloud health database, or sale of personal data, and the app contains no third-party ads. Limited app-performance and advertising-attribution data never includes your health entries.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION, EVERY FEATURE
• Fast daily symptom check-ins
• Medication schedules and dose tracking
• Lab result history
• Advanced 30- and 90-day symptom trends
• Personal pattern summaries
• Evidence-graded menopause reference library
• Clinician-ready reports
• Local backup and restore

SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
MenoCompass requires an active auto-renewable monthly or annual subscription. There is no free tier or free trial. The exact price is shown before purchase, and payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID subscription settings.

Privacy Policy: https://menlopass.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://menlopass.vercel.app/terms.html

MenoCompass provides general health education and self-tracking. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace care from a qualified clinician.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release with subscription access to private symptom tracking, medication schedules, lab results, evidence-graded education, advanced trends, and clinician-ready reports.
en-US.promoText: Subscription required. Private menopause tracking, clear patterns, and reports built for better appointments.
